caption: The drawing depicts a wooden wall shelf with a curved, decorative support structure. The shelf is composed of several pieces of wood joined together, displaying a variety of natural wood grain patterns and colors, primarily shades of brown ranging from light to dark. The shelf has a smoothly finished top plank, a horizontal central plank forming the base, and two distinct sinuous supports below for stability and aesthetic effect. The wood shows darker knots and subtle color variations. Two screws or pegs are visible on the lower part of the shelf, attaching parts of the structure together. The background is a plain, light tan color with a few scattered, faint markings. The artist's name, Carl Keksi, appears in small text at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Wall Shelf
